blocks.zh: Section 1: PQS Foundation (1.1–1.8)｜藥品品質系統基礎
blocks.en: Section 1: PQS Foundation (1.1–1.8)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ICH Q10 作為 藥品品質系統（PQS） 模型的定位，以及它如何以 ISO、GMP 法規和 ICH Q8/Q9 為基礎
blocks.en: Understand the position of ICH Q10 as a model for a Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS), and how it builds on ISO, GMP regulations and ICH Q8/Q9

blocks.zh: 掌握 Q10 適用的四個 產品生命週期階段（藥品開發、技術移轉、商業製造、產品停產）及各階段所涵蓋的活動
blocks.en: Know the four product lifecycle stages to which Q10 applies (pharmaceutical development, technology transfer, commercial manufacturing, product discontinuation) and the activities covered at each stage

blocks.zh: 清楚分辨 Q10 的 三大目標：產品實現、建立並維持受控狀態、促進持續改善
blocks.en: Clearly distinguish the three objectives of Q10: achieve product realisation, establish and maintain a state of control, and facilitate continual improvement

blocks.zh: 理解 知識管理 與 品質風險管理 作為 Q10 兩大使能工具（Enablers）的角色與作用
blocks.en: Understand the role of knowledge management and quality risk management as the two enablers of Q10

blocks.zh: 了解 Quality Manual（品質手冊） 的法規要求內容，以及其在 CDMO 或製藥廠中的實際形態
blocks.en: Understand what the regulations expect of a Quality Manual, and what it actually looks like at a CDMO or pharmaceutical plant

blocks.zh: 1.1 Introduction｜導論
blocks.en: 1.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 重要提示：Q10 不創造新法規要求
blocks.en: Key point: Q10 does not create new regulatory requirements

blocks.zh: 這是許多公司（尤其是中小型製藥廠和 CDMO）常見的誤解。Q10 是一個模型（model），不是一套新的強制法規。如果你已符合 FDA 21 CFR Part 211 或 EU GMP Part I，Q10 中超出 GMP 要求的內容是選用性（optional）的。
blocks.en: This is a common misunderstanding at many companies (especially small and mid-sized manufacturers and CDMOs). Q10 is a model, not a new set of mandatory regulations. If you already comply with FDA 21 CFR Part 211 or EU GMP Part I, anything in Q10 that goes beyond GMP requirements is optional.

blocks.zh: 但這並不代表 Q10 不重要——它提供一個系統性的框架，讓廠商主動超越最低要求，建立真正有效的品質文化。
blocks.en: That does not make Q10 unimportant. It provides a systematic framework that lets a company proactively go beyond the minimum requirements and build a genuinely effective quality culture.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：PQS 是什麼？
blocks.en: Analogy: what is a PQS?

blocks.zh: 把製藥廠想像成一家高端餐廳。GMP 法規是衛生局規定的最低衛生標準（洗手、食材溫度等）。ISO 標準是餐廳管理系統的國際最佳實務（如 ISO 22000 食品安全管理）。Q8 是廚師的食譜設計哲學（科學地設計每道菜）。
blocks.en: Think of a pharmaceutical plant as a high-end restaurant. GMP regulations are the minimum hygiene standards set by the health authority (handwashing, ingredient temperatures, and so on). ISO standards are international best practice for restaurant management systems (such as ISO 22000 for food safety management). Q8 is the chef's philosophy of recipe design (designing every dish scientifically).

blocks.zh: ICH Q10（PQS） 則是整個餐廳的「營運管理系統」——從採購、備料、廚房管理、品管試菜、客訴處理，到訓練員工、持續改善菜單的完整架構。它整合了衛生標準（GMP）和食譜哲學（Q8/Q9），讓高品質在每一天、每一道菜中持續實現。
blocks.en: ICH Q10 (PQS) is the "operating management system" of the whole restaurant: the complete framework running from purchasing, prep, kitchen management, tasting and quality checks, and complaint handling, through to staff training and continual menu improvement. It integrates hygiene standards (GMP) with recipe philosophy (Q8/Q9), so that high quality is delivered every day and in every dish.

blocks.zh: ICH Q-三合一架構（Q-Trilogy）
blocks.en: The ICH Q Trilogy (Q8, Q9, Q10)

blocks.zh: ICH Q8、Q9、Q10 是相互支撐的三部曲，共同構成現代製藥品質管理的科學基礎：
blocks.en: ICH Q8, Q9 and Q10 form a mutually supporting trilogy that together provides the scientific basis for modern pharmaceutical quality management:

blocks.zh: 三者的關係：Q8 告訴你「要把什麼品質建入產品」，Q9 告訴你「如何評估和管理風險」，Q10 告訴你「用什麼系統架構確保上述能持續有效執行」。
blocks.en: How the three relate: Q8 tells you "what quality to build into the product", Q9 tells you "how to assess and manage risk", and Q10 tells you "what system architecture ensures all of this keeps being carried out effectively".

blocks.zh: 1.2 Scope｜適用範圍
blocks.en: 1.2 Scope

blocks.zh: 常被忽略的兩個細節
blocks.en: Two details that are often overlooked

blocks.zh: 生物技術產品也在範圍內：Q10 明確包含 biotechnology 和 biological products（如單株抗體、疫苗）。這些產品的 PQS 複雜度通常高於小分子藥物，Q10 的框架同樣適用。
blocks.en: Biotechnology products are also in scope: Q10 explicitly includes biotechnology and biological products (such as monoclonal antibodies and vaccines). The PQS for these products is usually more complex than for small-molecule drugs, and the Q10 framework applies equally.

blocks.zh: 產品停產不是「什麼都不用做」：停產後仍有三項義務——文件保留（通常需保存至少 1 年以上或至最短效期後若干年）、樣品保留（留樣義務依各地法規）、持續評估與通報（如上市後安全性報告 PSUR/PBRER）。
blocks.en: Product discontinuation does not mean "nothing left to do": three obligations remain after discontinuation: document retention (typically at least one year, or a set number of years beyond the last expiry date), retention of samples (according to regional regulations), and continued evaluation and reporting (such as post-marketing safety reports, e.g. PSUR/PBRER).

blocks.zh: Technology Transfer 是高風險節點
blocks.en: Technology transfer is a high-risk node

blocks.zh: 技術移轉是製程知識「最容易流失」的環節。想像你把一道精緻甜點的食譜從主廚（開發廠）交給另一家廚房（製造廠）執行。如果只交一張紙質食譜（NDA/CTD 申請文件），而沒有充分傳遞「為什麼要用這個溫度」、「這個攪拌速度的 Design Space 是什麼」，接收廚房就只能「照單全收」，一旦有任何細微條件不同，批次就可能失敗。
blocks.en: Technology transfer is where process knowledge is most easily lost. Imagine handing the recipe for a delicate dessert from the head chef (the development site) to another kitchen (the manufacturing site). If you hand over only a paper recipe (the NDA/CTD filing) without fully conveying "why this temperature" or "what the Design Space is for this mixing speed", the receiving kitchen can only follow the recipe literally, and if any small condition differs, the batch may fail.

blocks.zh: Q10 要求技術移轉過程中系統性地轉移知識，不只是轉移程序——這正是知識管理（1.6.1）在技術移轉階段的核心體現。
blocks.en: Q10 requires that technology transfer systematically transfers knowledge, not just procedures. This is exactly where knowledge management (1.6.1) applies most directly at the technology transfer stage.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用
blocks.en: Practical application for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO，Q10 的四階段範圍直接對應其業務模式：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the four lifecycle stages in the Q10 scope map directly onto its business model:

blocks.zh: 開發服務（CRO/CDMO早期）：藥品開發階段——建立開發包，符合 Q10 知識管理要求
blocks.en: Development services (CRO / early-stage CDMO): the pharmaceutical development stage. Build the development package and meet the Q10 knowledge management expectations

blocks.zh: 技術移轉服務：這是 CDMO 的核心競爭力——能否系統性接收客戶知識並成功重現製程
blocks.en: Technology transfer services: this is the core competence of a CDMO, namely whether it can systematically receive the client's knowledge and successfully reproduce the process

blocks.zh: 商業生產（CMO）：Q10 的 CAPA、CPV、變更管理是 GMP 合規的日常骨幹
blocks.en: Commercial manufacturing (CMO): Q10 elements such as CAPA, CPV and change management are the day-to-day backbone of GMP compliance

blocks.zh: 客戶產品停產：CDMO 仍需依法保留製程文件和留樣，即便客戶已不再付費
blocks.en: Client product discontinuation: a CDMO must still retain process documentation and retained samples as required by law, even after the client has stopped paying

blocks.zh: 1.3–1.4 Relationships to GMP/ISO/ICH Q7 and Regulatory Approaches｜與法規及法規方法之關係
blocks.en: 1.3–1.4 Relationships to GMP/ISO/ICH Q7 and Regulatory Approaches

blocks.zh: 「Commensurate」——法規比例原則
blocks.en: "Commensurate": the principle of proportionality in regulation

blocks.zh: 1.4 節的核心詞是 commensurate（相稱、相應）——法規機關對廠商的監管強度應與廠商對產品和製程的理解程度、QRM 結果及 PQS 效能相稱。
blocks.en: The key word in Section 1.4 is commensurate: the intensity of regulatory oversight of a manufacturer should be commensurate with the manufacturer's level of product and process understanding, the results of QRM, and PQS performance.

blocks.zh: 這意味著：
blocks.en: This means:

blocks.zh: 產品/製程理解越深、PQS 越健全 → 監管機關可以給予更多彈性（如降低查驗頻率、允許更快的變更審查）
blocks.en: The deeper the product/process understanding and the more robust the PQS, the more flexibility regulators can give (for example, lower inspection frequency or faster review of changes)

blocks.zh: PQS 效能差、偏差多、CAPA 失效 → 監管機關有理由採取更嚴格的監管行動（Warning Letter、進口警示）
blocks.en: Poor PQS performance, many deviations and ineffective CAPA give regulators grounds for stricter action (Warning Letter, import alert)

blocks.zh: PQS 效能的評估通常在現場查廠（Regulatory Inspection）時進行
blocks.en: PQS performance is usually assessed during a regulatory inspection at the site

blocks.zh: GMP 是地板，Q10 是建設整棟大樓
blocks.en: GMP is the floor; Q10 builds the whole building

blocks.zh: Regional GMP 只覆蓋「商業製造」這一階段（且詳細到不同程度）。FDA 21 CFR Part 211 幾乎不談開發階段，EU GMP Part II（Q7 equivalent）才覆蓋 API 開發。但沒有任何 GMP 系統性地覆蓋整個產品生命週期從開發到停產。
blocks.en: Regional GMP covers only the commercial manufacturing stage (and in varying levels of detail). FDA 21 CFR Part 211 says almost nothing about development, and only EU GMP Part II (the Q7 equivalent) covers API development. But no GMP system covers the entire product lifecycle from development to discontinuation.

blocks.zh: Q10 填補了這個空白——尤其是開發階段（Pharmaceutical Development）和停產階段（Discontinuation），這兩個階段傳統 GMP 幾乎未觸及，卻是知識流失和合規風險的高發區。
blocks.en: Q10 fills this gap, especially the development stage (Pharmaceutical Development) and the discontinuation stage (Discontinuation). Traditional GMP barely touches these two stages, yet they are hot spots for knowledge loss and compliance risk.

blocks.zh: Q10 的法規層次定位
blocks.en: Where Q10 sits in the regulatory hierarchy

blocks.zh: 理解 Q10 在法規金字塔中的位置非常重要：
blocks.en: It is important to understand where Q10 sits in the regulatory pyramid:

blocks.zh: ICH Q7 專門針對 API（原料藥）的 GMP，其與 Q10 的關係：Q7 是 API 的 GMP 強制要求，Q10 在 Q7 基礎上提供更完整的系統性架構（如正式的知識管理和管理審查要求）。
blocks.en: ICH Q7 is the GMP guideline specifically for APIs (active pharmaceutical ingredients). Its relationship to Q10: Q7 is the mandatory GMP requirement for APIs, and Q10 builds on Q7 with a more complete systematic framework (such as formal knowledge management and management review requirements).

blocks.zh: 1.5 ICH Q10 Objectives｜Q10 三大目標
blocks.en: 1.5 ICH Q10 Objectives

blocks.zh: 三大目標的邏輯關係
blocks.en: The logic linking the three objectives

blocks.zh: 三個目標不是並列無關的，而有內在的邏輯順序：
blocks.en: The three objectives are not parallel and unrelated; they follow an inherent logical order:

blocks.zh: 先實現（Product Realisation）：系統設計得能做出好產品，是最基本的出發點
blocks.en: First achieve (Product Realisation): a system designed to make good product is the most basic starting point

blocks.zh: 再維持（State of Control）：能做出好產品之後，需要有監控系統確保這個狀態持續存在，不隨時間漂移
blocks.en: Then maintain (State of Control): once good product can be made, you need a monitoring system to ensure this condition persists and does not drift over time

blocks.zh: 最後改善（Continual Improvement）：在穩定受控的基礎上，主動尋找提升空間——這才是真正「成熟」的品質系統的體現
blocks.en: Finally improve (Continual Improvement): on a stable, controlled foundation, actively look for room to improve. This is what marks a truly "mature" quality system

blocks.zh: 許多公司的 PQS 只做到第一層（能放行批次），卻缺少監控系統（第二層）和改善文化（第三層）。Q10 的精髓在於推動廠商走完全程。
blocks.en: Many companies' PQS reaches only the first level (able to release batches), lacking a monitoring system (level two) and a culture of improvement (level three). The essence of Q10 is to push manufacturers through all three.

blocks.zh: 「State of Control」不等於「零偏差」
blocks.en: "State of Control" does not mean "zero deviations"

blocks.zh: 受控狀態（State of Control）的意義常被誤解為「沒有任何偏差或超標」。正確理解是：製程表現在預期範圍內，且變異來源被理解和管控。
blocks.en: The meaning of state of control is often misunderstood as "no deviations or out-of-specification results at all". The correct understanding is: process performance is within the expected range, and sources of variability are understood and controlled.

blocks.zh: 即使偶爾出現偏差，只要：① 能及時偵測、② 調查根本原因、③ 採取有效 CAPA，仍可認為 PQS 在「受控狀態」。反之，如果數據顯示製程能力（Cpk）持續下降、趨勢告警未被跟進，即使短期未有 OOS，也是「失控」的前兆。
blocks.en: Even if deviations occasionally occur, the PQS can still be considered in a "state of control" as long as (1) they are detected promptly, (2) the root cause is investigated, and (3) effective CAPA is taken. Conversely, if the data show process capability (Cpk) steadily declining and trend alerts going unfollowed, that is a warning sign of loss of control even if there has been no OOS in the short term.

blocks.zh: 1.6 Enablers: Knowledge Management and Quality Risk Management｜使能工具
blocks.en: 1.6 Enablers: Knowledge Management and Quality Risk Management

blocks.zh: 知識管理比喻：電子病歷系統（EMR）
blocks.en: Knowledge management analogy: the electronic medical record (EMR) system

blocks.zh: 藥品的知識管理就像醫院的電子病歷系統（Electronic Medical Record, EMR）。
blocks.en: Knowledge management for medicines is like a hospital's Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system.

blocks.zh: 在 EMR 出現之前，每個科別的醫生只看得到自己的病歷記錄——內科不知道病人的骨科手術史，急診室不知道病人的過敏史，造成重複檢查和用藥風險。
blocks.en: Before EMRs, doctors in each department could see only their own records. Internal medicine did not know the patient's orthopedic surgery history, and the emergency room did not know the patient's allergies, leading to duplicate tests and medication risks.

blocks.zh: 有了 EMR，所有病歷整合在一個系統，任何主治醫師在任何地點都能查到病人完整的治療史、過敏資訊、基因報告。
blocks.en: With an EMR, all records are integrated in one system, and any attending physician at any location can look up the patient's complete treatment history, allergy information and genetic reports.

blocks.zh: 藥品知識管理的理想同樣如此：從早期開發的 DoE 數據、技術移轉的批次記錄、商業生產的 CAPA、到年度產品審查（APQR）——所有知識都應結構化儲存、跨部門可查詢、不因人員異動而流失。許多 GMP 缺失（483 observations）的根源，正是知識管理失敗——製程異常的根本原因在十年前已調查過，只是沒人找得到那份記錄。
blocks.en: The ideal for pharmaceutical knowledge management is the same: from DoE data in early development, to batch records from technology transfer, to CAPA from commercial production, to the Annual Product Quality Review (APQR), all knowledge should be stored in a structured way, searchable across departments, and not lost when people move on. The root cause of many GMP findings (483 observations) is a failure of knowledge management: the root cause of a process anomaly was investigated ten years ago, but nobody can find that record.

blocks.zh: 知識的九大來源
blocks.en: The nine sources of knowledge

blocks.zh: Q10 明確列出知識管理的資訊來源，值得逐一理解其在實際工作中的形態：
blocks.en: Q10 explicitly lists the sources of information for knowledge management. It is worth understanding what each looks like in practice:

blocks.zh: Prior knowledge（先驗知識）：文獻、公開資料庫、公司平台技術的歷史數據
blocks.en: Prior knowledge: literature, public databases, historical data from company platform technologies

blocks.zh: Pharmaceutical development studies：DoE、處方開發報告、穩定性研究
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical development studies: DoE, formulation development reports, stability studies

blocks.zh: Technology transfer activities：技術移轉報告（TTR）、可比性研究
blocks.en: Technology transfer activities: technology transfer reports (TTR), comparability studies

blocks.zh: Process validation studies：PPQ 批次報告、驗證彙整報告
blocks.en: Process validation studies: PPQ batch reports, validation summary reports

blocks.zh: Manufacturing experience：批次記錄、偏差報告、APQR
blocks.en: Manufacturing experience: batch records, deviation reports, APQR

blocks.zh: Innovation：新製程技術、新分析方法、PAT 引入
blocks.en: Innovation: new process technologies, new analytical methods, introduction of PAT

blocks.zh: Continual improvement：改善提案、六西格瑪計畫成果
blocks.en: Continual improvement: improvement proposals, results of Six Sigma projects

blocks.zh: Change management activities：變更申請（CCR）及其評估結果
blocks.en: Change management activities: change control requests (CCR) and their assessment results

blocks.zh: QRM 是「主動式」，不是「被動式」
blocks.en: QRM is "proactive", not "reactive"

blocks.zh: 品質風險管理（QRM）的關鍵字是 proactive（主動的）——在問題發生之前識別和控制風險，而非事後救火。
blocks.en: The key word in quality risk management (QRM) is proactive: identify and control risk before problems occur, rather than firefighting afterwards.

blocks.zh: 在 PQS 架構下，QRM 應該貫穿整個生命週期：
blocks.en: Within a PQS, QRM should run through the entire lifecycle:

blocks.zh: 開發階段：FMEA 識別製程關鍵步驟，指導 DoE 優先順序
blocks.en: Development stage: FMEA identifies critical process steps and guides DoE prioritisation

blocks.zh: 技術移轉：風險評估決定哪些參數需要重新驗證
blocks.en: Technology transfer: risk assessment determines which parameters need to be revalidated

blocks.zh: 商業製造：定期風險審查，識別製程漂移的早期警號
blocks.en: Commercial manufacturing: periodic risk review identifies early warning signs of process drift

blocks.zh: 變更管理：變更前風險評估，決定變更程度和需要的監管申報層級
blocks.en: Change management: pre-change risk assessment determines the extent of the change and the level of regulatory filing required

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 提供工具箱（FMEA、HACCP、魚骨圖、故障樹等）——Q10 告訴你何時以及在哪個系統中使用這些工具。
blocks.en: ICH Q9 provides the toolbox (FMEA, HACCP, fishbone diagrams, fault trees, etc.); Q10 tells you when and within which system to use these tools.

blocks.zh: 1.7 Design and Content Considerations｜設計與內容考量
blocks.en: 1.7 Design and Content Considerations

blocks.zh: 「Site Level」——PQS 效能在廠房層次證明
blocks.en: "Site Level": PQS performance is demonstrated at the site

blocks.zh: 1.7(c) 特別指出 PQS 的效能是在site（廠房）層次展現的。這有幾個重要意涵：
blocks.en: 1.7(c) specifically points out that PQS performance is demonstrated at the site level. This has several important implications:

blocks.zh: 公司可以有公司層級（corporate-level）的品質政策，但各廠房有自己的製造授權、查廠紀錄和 GMP 合規責任
blocks.en: A company may have a corporate-level quality policy, but each site has its own manufacturing authorisation, inspection history and GMP compliance responsibilities

blocks.zh: FDA/EMA 查廠時，是查具體廠房的 PQS 運作，而非公司總部的政策文件
blocks.en: When FDA/EMA inspect, they examine how the PQS operates at the specific site, not the policy documents at corporate headquarters

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，每個生產廠房的 PQS 必須獨立、完整，即便屬於同一集團
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the PQS at each manufacturing site must be independent and complete, even if the sites belong to the same group

blocks.zh: 外包活動品質管控（1.7d）——CDMO 的雙重責任
blocks.en: Quality control of outsourced activities (1.7(d)): the CDMO's dual responsibility

blocks.zh: 外包活動（Outsourced Activities）在 CDMO 語境中有雙重含義：
blocks.en: Outsourced activities have a double meaning in the CDMO context:

blocks.zh: CDMO 作為受委託方：客戶（製藥公司）的 PQS 必須確保外包給 CDMO 的活動符合品質要求，包括定期供應商審核、Quality Agreement 簽訂、製程數據取得
blocks.en: The CDMO as the contract acceptor: the client's (pharmaceutical company's) PQS must ensure that activities outsourced to the CDMO meet quality requirements, including periodic supplier audits, a signed Quality Agreement, and access to process data

blocks.zh: CDMO 本身也外包：CDMO 可能把部分測試外包給第三方實驗室，或外包包裝、滅菌服務。CDMO 的 PQS 也必須管控這些下游外包活動
blocks.en: The CDMO also outsources: a CDMO may outsource some testing to third-party laboratories, or outsource packaging and sterilisation services. The CDMO's PQS must also control these downstream outsourced activities

blocks.zh: Quality Agreement（品質技術協議）是實現 1.7(d) 的核心文件，應明確規範雙方責任邊界、資訊共享要求、偏差通知流程。
blocks.en: The Quality Agreement is the core document for implementing 1.7(d). It should clearly define the boundaries of each party's responsibilities, information-sharing requirements and the deviation notification process.

blocks.zh: 1.8 Quality Manual｜品質手冊
blocks.en: 1.8 Quality Manual

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 Quality Manual 實務
blocks.en: The Quality Manual in CDMO practice

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，Quality Manual 通常採用兩層結構：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the Quality Manual usually adopts a two-tier structure:

blocks.zh: 公司層級（Corporate Quality Manual）：定義全集團共用的品質政策、核心價值、整體 PQS 架構，適用於所有廠房
blocks.en: Corporate level (Corporate Quality Manual): defines the quality policy, core values and overall PQS architecture shared across the group, applicable to all sites

blocks.zh: 廠房層級（Site Quality Manual / Site Quality System）：在公司政策基礎上，描述特定廠房的 PQS 範圍（如只生產無菌製劑）、廠房特定的製程地圖、當地管理責任架構
blocks.en: Site level (Site Quality Manual / Site Quality System): building on corporate policy, describes the PQS scope of a specific site (for example, sterile dosage forms only), site-specific process maps and the local management responsibility structure

blocks.zh: FDA 和 EMA 查廠時，稽查員通常優先要求查閱 Site Quality Manual 或等效文件，以在短時間內快速了解廠房 PQS 架構。一份結構清晰的 Quality Manual 能大幅提高查廠效率，也顯示廠商的 PQS 成熟度。
blocks.en: During FDA and EMA inspections, inspectors usually ask first to see the Site Quality Manual or an equivalent document, so they can quickly understand the site's PQS architecture in a short time. A clearly structured Quality Manual greatly improves inspection efficiency and also demonstrates the maturity of the company's PQS.

blocks.zh: 注意 Q10 允許「或等效文件（or equivalent documentation approach）」——Quality Manual 可以是一份整合文件，也可以是由多份 SOP/政策文件組成的文件體系，只要能清楚呈現上述四個元素即可。
blocks.en: Note that Q10 allows "or equivalent documentation approach": the Quality Manual can be a single consolidated document, or a documentation system made up of several SOPs/policy documents, as long as it clearly presents the four elements above.

blocks.zh: Process Maps — 視覺化 PQS 的利器
blocks.en: Process Maps: a powerful way to visualise the PQS

blocks.zh: Q10 特別提到流程圖（process maps / flow charts）作為呈現 PQS 製程的工具。在實務上：
blocks.en: Q10 specifically mentions process maps / flow charts as a way to present the PQS processes. In practice:

blocks.zh: Turtle Diagram：ISO 9001 常用的製程分析工具，呈現製程的輸入/輸出、所需資源、方法、監測指標
blocks.en: Turtle Diagram: a process analysis tool commonly used in ISO 9001, showing a process's inputs/outputs, required resources, methods and monitoring indicators

blocks.zh: SIPOC 圖：呈現 Supplier → Input → Process → Output → Customer 的高階流程關係
blocks.en: SIPOC diagram: shows the high-level process relationships Supplier, Input, Process, Output, Customer

blocks.zh: PQS 互動矩陣：一頁圖呈現各 PQS 子系統（CAPA、變更管理、偏差、文件控制等）之間的觸發和互動關係
blocks.en: PQS interaction matrix: a one-page diagram showing the triggers and interactions among PQS subsystems (CAPA, change management, deviations, document control, etc.)

blocks.zh: 查廠時，這些視覺化工具能讓稽查員快速理解廠房 PQS 架構，是體現「PQS 成熟度」的重要展示材料。
blocks.en: During an inspection, these visual tools let inspectors quickly understand the site's PQS architecture and are important showcase material for demonstrating "PQS maturity".

blocks.zh: 自我測試 Self-Assessment Questions
blocks.en: Self-Assessment Questions

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 明確聲明不創造新法規要求。那麼，一家已完全符合 EU GMP Part I 的歐洲藥廠，Q10 中哪些內容是強制的？哪些是選用的？請舉例說明。
blocks.en: ICH Q10 explicitly states that it does not create new regulatory requirements. So for a European pharmaceutical plant that already fully complies with EU GMP Part I, which parts of Q10 are mandatory and which are optional? Please give examples.

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 同時承接早期臨床（Phase I）和商業化製造（commercial）的業務。Q10 的「適當且相稱（appropriate and proportionate）」原則要求他們如何差異化設計 PQS？兩個階段的 PQS 要求有什麼關鍵差異？
blocks.en: A CDMO takes on both early clinical (Phase I) and commercial manufacturing business. How does the Q10 principle of "appropriate and proportionate" require them to differentiate their PQS design? What are the key differences in PQS requirements between the two stages?

blocks.zh: Q10 的三大目標中，「建立並維持受控狀態（State of Control）」和「持續改善（Continual Improvement）」有什麼本質區別？能否以 CPV（Continued Process Verification）為例，說明這兩個目標如何在同一個系統中並存？
blocks.en: Of the three Q10 objectives, what is the essential difference between "establish and maintain a state of control" and "continual improvement"? Using CPV (Continued Process Verification) as an example, explain how these two objectives coexist in the same system.

blocks.zh: 一家公司的品質手冊（Quality Manual）只包含品質政策和 PQS 範圍，但沒有製程地圖和管理責任章節。如果 FDA 查廠，稽查員可能會提出什麼形式的缺失（483 observation 或 Warning Letter 觀察項目）？
blocks.en: A company's Quality Manual contains only the quality policy and the PQS scope, with no process maps and no management responsibility section. In an FDA inspection, what kind of finding (483 observation or Warning Letter citation) might the inspector raise?

blocks.zh: Quality Manual 的四個必要元素
blocks.en: The four required elements of a Quality Manual

blocks.zh: Q10 要求 Quality Manual（或等效文件）必須涵蓋四個面向：
blocks.en: Q10 requires that the Quality Manual (or equivalent documentation) cover four aspects:

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Q10 的本質：基於 ISO 品質概念、涵蓋 GMP 要求、補充 Q8/Q9 的 PQS 模型；不創造新法規要求，超出 GMP 部分為選用性內容
blocks.en: The essence of Q10: a PQS model based on ISO quality concepts, incorporating GMP requirements and complementing Q8/Q9; it does not create new regulatory requirements, and content beyond GMP is optional

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：涵蓋 DS 和 DP（含生技/生物製品）的整個生命週期——四個階段：藥品開發、技術移轉、商業製造、產品停產
blocks.en: Scope: covers the entire lifecycle of both drug substances and drug products (including biotechnology/biological products) across four stages: pharmaceutical development, technology transfer, commercial manufacturing and product discontinuation

blocks.zh: 法規定位：Regional GMP + ICH Q7 + ISO 構成基礎層；Q10 在此之上提供統一的整個生命週期 PQS 模型；法規監管強度應與廠商 PQS 效能相稱
blocks.en: Regulatory positioning: regional GMP + ICH Q7 + ISO form the base layer; Q10 provides a unified lifecycle-wide PQS model on top of it; the intensity of regulatory oversight should be commensurate with the manufacturer's PQS performance

blocks.zh: 三大目標：① 產品實現（Product Realisation）→ ② 受控狀態（State of Control）→ ③ 持續改善（Continual Improvement）——三者有邏輯遞進關係
blocks.en: Three objectives: (1) Product Realisation, then (2) State of Control, then (3) Continual Improvement. The three follow a logical progression

blocks.zh: 兩大使能工具：知識管理（系統性管理產品/製程知識，跨整個生命週期不流失）+ 品質風險管理（主動識別和控制品質風險，連結 ICH Q9）
blocks.en: Two enablers: knowledge management (systematically managing product/process knowledge so it is not lost across the lifecycle) + quality risk management (proactively identifying and controlling quality risk, linked to ICH Q9)

blocks.zh: PQS 設計要點：結構清晰、與生命週期階段和公司規模相稱、包含外包活動管控、明確管理責任、涵蓋四大 PQS 元素、建立績效指標
blocks.en: PQS design points: clear structure, proportionate to lifecycle stage and company size, includes control of outsourced activities, clear management responsibility, covers the four PQS elements, and establishes performance indicators

blocks.zh: Quality Manual：必須包含品質政策、PQS 範圍、製程地圖與連結關係、管理責任四個核心元素；CDMO 通常採公司層級 + 廠房層級兩層架構
blocks.en: Quality Manual: must contain four core elements: quality policy, PQS scope, process maps and linkages, and management responsibility; a CDMO usually adopts a two-tier corporate + site structure
